title: Refund window
answer: Refunds are usually available within 14 days if the purchase was delivered and not consumed. Already refunded invoices cannot be refunded again.

title: Payment failed
answer: For failed card payments, ask the customer to check bank limits, 3-D Secure confirmation, and whether money was captured. If delivery_status is not_delivered, do not promise access until payment succeeds.

title: Purchase not delivered yet
answer: If a paid invoice has pending delivery, ask the customer to wait a few minutes, then escalate with invoice_id, game and payment method if the item is still missing.

title: Subscription cancellation
answer: A subscription can be cancelled any time. Renewal refunds are reviewed within 48 hours of the charge.

title: Chargeback handling
answer: Chargeback or stolen-card reports should be routed to the risk team. Do not create a refund ticket until ownership and payment status are verified.
